description.value: Tim Hortons is a national Canadian coffee chain offering brewed coffee, specialty beverages, baked goods, wraps, soups, and hot breakfast items at its Valemount outpost on Swift Creek Road. In a small, remote mountain community sitting between Prince George and Jasper on Highway 5, this is one of very few quick-service food options available to touring cyclists resupplying in Valemount. Both dine-in and take-out service are available.
